agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Monday, June 02, 2014 - 07:00 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Councilmember Waronek
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
Presentation of Certificates and Awards to Poster Contest Winners from the Gang and Drug Free Walk
Presentation of Certificates to Individuals of the Parent Teacher Association (PTA) to Publicly Acknowledge Their Outstanding Community Service to Children and Youth in Our Community
Introduction of Sheriff's Deputy, Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department - Lomita Station
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a 5 minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Recommendation to approve the minutes of the Special Meeting-Budget Workshop held on May 13, 2014 and the Special and Regular City Council meeting held on May 19, 2014. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
Minutes of 051314 and 051914
c.
Adopt Resolution 2014-20, Approving the Demands and Payroll. RECOMMEND ADOPT RESOLUTION.
Resolution 2014-20 Demands 060214
d.
Monthly Report for the Administrative Services Department. RECEIVE AND FILE.
Staff Report 7.d
e.
Monthly Report for the Community Development Department. RECEIVE AND FILE.
Staff Report 7.e
f.
Monthly Report for the Parks and Recreation Department. RECEIVE AND FILE.
Staff Report 7.f
g.
Monthly Report for the Public Works Department. RECEIVE AND FILE.
Staff Report 7.g
h.
April 2014 Treasurer's Report. RECEIVE AND FILE.
Staff Report 7.h
i.
Approval to Amend Contract with Pacific Municipal Consultants (PMC) to Provide Administrative Housing Consulting Services for the Lomita Housing Authority and Lomita Manor in an amount not to exceed $25,000 annually. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
Staff Report 7.i
j.
Adopt Ordinance No. 768, Code Amendment No. 2014-04 Adopting by Reference Title 32-Los Angeles County Fire Code. RECOMMEND ADOPT ORDINANCE.
Staff Report 7.j
k.
Adopt Ordinance No. 769, Creating a Procedure for the Issuance of Administrative Citations within the City and adopt Resolution No. 2014-26 Establishing a Fine Schedule. RECOMMEND ADOPT ORDINANCE AND RESOLUTION.
Staff Report 7.k
PUBLIC HEARING:
8.
ADOPTION OF 2014/15 FISCAL YEAR BUDGET. Discussion/consideration of adoption of the proposed budget for Fiscal Year 2014/15 and related Resolutions:
No. 2014-21 Adopting the Budget for Fiscal Year 2014/15
No. 2014-22 Adopting the Annual Investment Policy Statement
No. 2014-23 Adopting the Annual Employee Compensation Plan and;
No. 2014-24 Confirming the Factors Used for Calculating the GANN Annual Appropriations Limit.
Presented by City Manager Rock and Administrative Services Director Chavez.
Staff Report 8
9.
DISCUSSION AND INTRODUCTION OF ORDINANCE NO. 770, AMENDING THE LOMITA MUNICIPAL CODE TITLE V, CHAPTER 9 STANDARD URBAN STORM WATER PLAN MITIGATION IMPLEMENTATION AND ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. 2014-25, AFFIRMING CITY'S COMMITMENT TO THE IMPLEMENTATION OF LOW IMPACT DEVELOPMENT CONTROLS AFFECTING NEW DEVELOPMENTS AND A GREEN STREET POLICY IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY MUNICIPAL STORM WATER PERMIT.
Presented by Acting Public Works Director Shahbazi
Staff Report 9
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
10.
INSTALLATION OF RED CURB ON THE EAST AND WEST SIDE OF LUCILLE AVENUE SOUTH OF PACIFIC COAST HIGHWAY.
Presented by Traffic Advisor Guilmette
Staff Report 10
11.
APPROVAL OF A PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT (PSA) IN THE AMOUNT OF $39,980.00 WITH COATING SPECIALISTS AND INSPECTION SERVICES, INC., (CSI SERVICES) OF SANTA CLARITA (CONSULTANT) FOR INSPECTION SERVICES FOR THE HARBOR HILLS WATER STORAGE TANK REHABILITATION PROJECT.
Presented by Acting Public Works Director Shahbazi
Staff Report 11
12.
AWARD OF CONSTRUCTION CONTRACT IN THE AMOUNT OF $18,008.00 TO ND ELECTRICAL CONSTRUCTION, INC. FOR BUS BENCH AND TRASH CONTAINER REPOSITION.
Presented by Community Services Director McPherron
Staff Report 12
13.
APPROVE EXPENDITURE IN THE AMOUNT OF $35,000.00 OF AIR QUALITY MANAGEMENT DISTRICT (AQMD) FUNDS FOR PURCHASE OF ALTERNATIVE FUEL VEHICLE DESIGNATED FOR PARKING ENFORCEMENT USE.
Presented by Community Services Director McPherron
Staff Report 13
14.
ADJOURNMENT Lomita City Council will adjourn to a Special Meeting June 16, 2014 at 6:00 p.m. followed by the Regular Meeting at 7:00 p.m.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
